Base: Sensitive data is compromised though attacks against SSL/TLS
Model: A user's session ID is passed in the URL. This ID is leaked to third parties via the Referer header when the user clicks an external link, or is stored in browser history, proxy logs, or server logs. Exposure of the session ID allows an attacker to hijack the user's session and gain unauthorized access to their PII.
